video:video.video:title: Gokul Agro Resources Limited — Corporate Brand Film | Cinematographer Mehul Prajapati
video:video.video:description:
Founded in 2014 by Shri Kanubhai Thakkar, Gokul Agro Resources Limited (GARL) has grown into one of India's leading names in the edible oil industry — a story of scale, sustainability, and global reach told through this brand film.
GARL operates state-of-the-art manufacturing plants in Gandhidham (Gujarat), Krishnapatnam (Andhra Pradesh), and Haldia (West Bengal) — each strategically port-linked for supply-chain speed and export readiness. Together, these facilities maintain high refining, crushing, and storage capacities behind a wide portfolio of edible oils, including soybean, mustard, sunflower, and palm oil, alongside castor derivatives and feed meals.
Sustainability runs through GARL's operations, with wind, solar, and biodiesel now powering over 30% of energy needs — part of a broader commitment to eco-conscious practices, especially in castor oil production. This transparent, factory-floor storytelling gives distributors, institutional buyers, and international stakeholders a real look at the capability and quality systems behind every shipment, backed by internationally recognized certifications.
With a distribution network spanning 23 Indian states and a presence in 38 countries, GARL serves both household and institutional clients across the globe. Looking ahead, the company is expanding its green initiatives — including eco-friendly palm plantations in India — and growing its refining capacity in Indonesia by 2025–26, strengthening its position as a trusted global player in edible and non-edible oils.
📍 Gandhidham, Gujarat · Krishnapatnam, Andhra Pradesh · Haldia, West Bengal 🌍 Serving 23 states in India and 38 countries worldwide
